ontario-newsroom:1008328.editorial_source_notes: Ontario’s November 26 release describes provincial support for an automated facility producing wood trusses and wall components. The October 8 company release reports commissioning completed for the first robotic roof-truss line.

ontario-ero:026-1135.editorial_source_notes: Registry notice 026-1135 is a proposal posted November 26. It lists Vaughan as the mobile facility location and Ontario-wide operation. The scope covers trailer design and fabrication for wastewater treatment.

ontario-ero:026-1220.editorial_source_notes: Registry notice 026-1220 is an amendment proposal posted November 25. It lists Lot 9, Concession B, Commanda, and describes the property as west of North Bay. Proposed changes include the replacement 1,860-square-metre building and a generator.

ontario-ero:026-0008.editorial_source_notes: Registry notice 026-0008 is a decision posted November 24. Waterdown is the proponent location. The approval covers a mobile crusher, screener, transfer and stacker conveyors, and a 404 kW generator.
